integrity: Fully quantified proof; explicit cyclotomic identities and a reproducible finite check; finite tests are supplementary and do not certify novelty or an infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integral cubic parameter; densities over rational primes, excluding finitely many ramified primes in root-count and lifting formulas. No effective or uniform Chebotarev estimate, no higher-degree generalization or recurrence-term divisibility result.
title: Prime-divisor density dichotomy for the cubic ABC polynomial family
